_mechanism: security/gate.py misconfig --exceptions security/misconfig-exceptions.json --source-root <checkout>. A finding is EXCEPTED (and still printed) only while its check, its target file and its enclosing resource block resolved in the checked-out source match an entry, the matched instance count equals expected_instances, every condition holds against LITERAL values (an expression fails closed), and today (UTC) is before expires. An expired, stale, miscounted or condition-failing entry is a policy violation. security/README.md describes the mechanism and its negative controls.
_implementation_notes: A2's tree-scoped condition also covers aws_alb_listener (the AWS provider's alias of aws_lb_listener) and requires at least one listener block (min_blocks 1), so an empty or alias-typed tree cannot satisfy it vacuously.

Tree-scoped conditions fail closed on any construct a textual reading cannot see through anywhere in tree_scope: a .tofu or .tofu.json file, a module whose source is not a local path (the residual recorded by review round 4 of the packet), a provisioner, a generic provisioning resource (CloudFormation, Cloud Control, awscc_*) and data.external.

Resource-scoped conditions fail closed when the target's module directory holds an override file or a .tofu file, or declares the resource more than once: Trivy reports such a change at the original block, which the condition would otherwise read.
A1 also pins cidr_ipv4 to the literal 0.0.0.0/0 and requires prefix_list_id and referenced_security_group_id to be absent, so the exception covers exactly the reviewed rule shape.
